title: Mother and Toddler, Backyard Patio Umbrella - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-century domestic scene capturing a mother sitting under a fringed patio umbrella on a folding lawn chair, holding an infant or toddler on her lap. Beside her, a young girl in overalls kneels on a matching folding chair, looking toward them. The setting is a bright, sun-dappled backyard framed by lush garden foliage and the shingle siding of a family home, reflecting everyday postwar suburban life in mid-20th-century America. The print features deckled (scalloped) edges typical of consumer snapshots from the late 1940s and 1950s.
